facts.text: The Bachelor of Science in Computer Science in Real-Time Interactive Simulation (RTIS) degree requires at least 134 credits over eight 15-week semesters.

sources.title: Computer Science in Real-Time Interactive Simulation | DigiPen
sources.quote: The Bachelor of Science in Computer Science in Real-Time Interactive Simulation degree program requires completion of at least 134 credits with a cumulative GPA of 2.0 or better.
